description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for articles, including the command, validation logic, and handler to process deletion requests based on article slug.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the delete command, ensuring the slug is neither null nor empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion process by querying the article and removing it from the database.

methods.name: CommandValidator.constructor
methods.description: Sets validation rules for the command's slug property.

methods.name: QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion logic: fetches the article by slug, throws exception if not found, removes it, and saves changes.
